field: initial load
note: Baseline built from primary sources: Metro Vancouver DCC page and the City of Vancouver DCL Bulletin (amended 2026-01-22).

field: Utilities DCL
note: First pass took $39.06/m2 from an industry blog. The City's own DCL Bulletin Table 1 gives $31.25/m2 for the at-or-below 1.2 FSR band. The blog figure was wrong.

field: DCL rate structure
note: First pass treated the residential DCL as one flat rate. It is banded by density: $81.13/m2 at or below 1.2 FSR, $174.67 from 1.2-1.5 FSR, $349.54 above 1.5 FSR. Using the lowest band for an apartment project understated Vancouver DCLs roughly 4x.

field: TransLink DCC
note: TransLink DCC found in Bulletin Appendix E and added to the calculator. Only 2025 and 2026 rates are published.

field: Burnaby DCC / ACC
note: The $38.54/unit townhouse figure came from a Surrey comparator report and was wrong. Burnaby's own rate table gives townhouse DCC $37,423/unit plus ACC $18,874. Full DCC+ACC schedule loaded, plus Community Benefit Bonus density rates.

field: Surrey status
note: Surrey's own site names Bylaw 21174 (May 2024) as current. The 2026 rates are with the Inspector of Municipalities and not in force. Split into separate proposed rows; in-force schedule left unloaded rather than guessed.

field: Richmond / New West / Coquitlam / Langley
note: Unverified third-hand figures removed rather than carried. These four jurisdictions now show no rate and are flagged for a primary-source pass.
